claims.statement: The renderer runs sandboxed with contextIsolation and exposes only piBridge; the preload only trusts app://bundle or a Vite dev server at localhost:5173/127.0.0.1:5173 (preload-location-policy.ts).
preload-message-policy.ts validates that exactly one well-shaped MessagePort (postMessage/start/close) is transferred and that deep-link session ids are strict UUIDs before forwarding.
isTrustedDesktopIpcSender (src/main/ipc-trust.ts) requires the IPC sender to be the main BrowserWindow's webContents and its main frame, rejecting nested-frame or other-window senders.

CredentialVault (src/main/credential-vault.ts) persists channel credentials to a 0o600 JSON file as safeStorage.encryptString blobs Brief, refuses to run when safeStorage is unavailable, and validates keys strict against channel:(weixin|telegram|feishu).
BrowserSecretVault stores encrypted browser header secrets referenced by opaque refs, refusing values over 64KB or containing NUL so plaintext never reaches the renderer or logs.
Channel secrets are fingerprinted (last 4 chars) and recuctively redacted in redaction.ts, and safeChannelError routes all surfaced channel errors through redactChannelText capped at 500 chars.
Browser url/text redaction (browser-redaction.ts) strips URLs of credentials and sensitive query keys and redacts bearer/api-key/password patterns before agent-visible content.
Diagnostics redaction (diagnostics-redaction.ts) substitutes userData/logs/home directory paths and redacts authorization/proxy-authorization headers.

Toolchain downloads are verified ( SHA-256 hash and bytes) against a signed RuntimeCatalogVariant, and HTTPS redirects are limited to a fixed allow-list of artifact hostnames via assertRuntimeRedirectUrl.

scripts/check-desktop-security.mjs is a compile-time security gate run under verify.mjs that asserts source invariants including sandboxing, preload policy, IPC trust, redaction usage, Windows helper containment, and credential vault usage.
